claims.text: IOrderRepository (DonHang.Domain) declares FindAsync(int), ListByCustomerAsync(int), AddAsync(Order) and SaveChangesAsync().

EfOrderRepository (DonHang.Infrastructure) takes DonHangDbContext; FindAsync uses Include(o => o.Items).FirstOrDefaultAsync; ListByCustomerAsync uses Where, Include(o => o.Customer), OrderBy(o => o.Id), ToListAsync; AddAsync and SaveChangesAsync forward to the DbContext.
OrderService calls only repository.FindAsync, AddAsync and SaveChangesAsync and has no reference to EF Core, DbSet or Include.
FakeOrderRepository in DonHang.Tests implements IOrderRepository with a Dictionary<int, Order>, and OrderServiceTests run OrderService against it with no database.
ListByCustomerAsync was added for the order list endpoint (GET /api/v1/orders), marked for backend.l1.efcore-n-plus-one.

A C# class implementing an interface must provide every member the interface declares without a default body (all four IOrderRepository members have none), so adding a method requires adding it to EfOrderRepository and FakeOrderRepository.
In EF Core, Include loads related entities in the same query, and a Where/Include/OrderBy chain ending in ToListAsync runs as one query.
claims.source_hint: EF Core docs: querying/related-data/eager; overview of query execution

claims.text: A repository should offer a few methods named for what the business layer needs and keep the query details to itself.
OrderService.CancelOrderAsync throws KeyNotFoundException when repository.FindAsync returns null.
OrdersController.Get calls repository.FindAsync and List calls repository.ListByCustomerAsync directly, without OrderService.
In the API, IOrderRepository is registered as EfOrderRepository and DonHangDbContext uses Npgsql (PostgreSQL).
DonHangDbContext exposes six DbSet properties; DonHang.Domain.csproj references neither EF Core nor DonHang.Infrastructure.

self_check.notes: Outline retargeted to stage-1: IOrderRepository/EfOrderRepository exist. The in-memory test implementation is named by its class name only; test doubles as a term come in the unit-testing module. No Unit of Work, per depth_notes.
